programmes.d: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard.
Laa-Laa is playing indoors with her ball, the Noo Noo catches it and tidies it up. Laa-Laa chases the Noo Noo till she gets her ball back.
Boy makes a turban; Dipsy, Po and Laalaa play; Tinky Winky goes for a walk.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.
Becky goes on a tram ride and has an accident involving Po's scooter.
A voice trumpet brings a message for Dipsy and Laa-Laa which makes them laugh and run away. The Teletubbies watch some children dancing with King Pleasure and the Biscuit Boys.
The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park.

Po wants some Tubby Custard, but she doesn' t have time to eat is before watching some children do some painting in the garden. The Tubbies are very careful not to spill their Tubby Custard, but if they do, the Noo Noo will tidy up.
Tamzin Griffin pretends to be the Funny Lady; LaaLaa dances a secret dance.
The Teletubbies are feeling very happy. They run and dance around cheering and hugging. They stop to watch some children in South Africa looking at monkeys.
Tinky Winky finds Po sleeping in his bed; Andy Brown looks for snails.

The Teletubbies watch three boys fill a sand pendulum and make a picture. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa follow Po everywhere. The animals march through Teletubbyland, before it is time for Tubby Bye-Bye.
The Teletubbies watch Thomas and Jack having fun playing on the beach and building sandcastles. In Teletubbyland the Teletubbies are going round and round.
The Teletubbies learn about the number three just before three boats go sailing by.
A little girl uses different things to stick a face onto a pumpkin. A pumpkin appears in Teletubbyland. It has two ears, a nose, two eyes and a big smile.
A voice trumpet sounds while the Teletubbies sleep; a lion and bear come to Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make models of heads out of clay. Dipsy is very pleased with himself when he discovers his eyes, mouth, nose and ears.
Noo-Noo drives fast; children make a salad; dancing bear on the carousel.

Laa-Laa comes in through the door and up the slide to join the others and watch Christopher whose mum and dad look after poorly hedgehogs. A magical new event happens in Teletubbyland – Little Bo Peep has lost her sheep.
The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle.
Laa-Laa jumps indoors and then runs off to watch some children sing and act out the nursery rhyme 'Old King Cole'. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies act out their own version of 'Old King Cole'.
Children learn about all things green; the Teletubbies pick Dipsy as their favorite green thing.

A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies ‘Christmas is a Coming’. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue.

Bryony loves to play the violin. She talks about her violin and they plays 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star'. The Teletubbies sit down to listen to some lovely music, but the Noo Noo is making too much noise.
Natalie tells the Teletubbies about her brother's christening; magic cloud.
The Teletubbies play a swapping places game among the hills. They watch a little girl paint a portrait of her mum. A book appears and Tinky Winky looks at the pictures in the book.
The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed.
Dipsy is busy at the switch panel, when he remembers the snow. The Tubbies watch an international Christmas insert. The Teletubbies are walking very carefully because snow can be very slippery.

The Teletubbies play with their favourite things, until the windmill shows them it's time to watch some children learn about the number one. The Teletubbies are supposed to be in bed, but they would rather play outside.
The Teletubbies watch boys spin some special spinning tops to celebrate Hanukah.
The Teletubbies play a game before watching some children playing a game with Alex Pascall. The Teletubbies have fun playing the game of waking and sleeping, before Tubby Bye-Bye.
The Teletubbies dance; Yvette washes her plastic cups and saucers; messy day.
The Teletubbies watch as Andy Brown shows some children butterflies. The Teletubbies love to fly their kites and a strong wind blows Po all over Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets.
Some children learn about the number four, and the Teletubbies decide to go into the house. One by one, they leave. So, who is in the house?
A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'.
The Tubbies watch a little girl have her hair braided by her mum. They put different coloured bands in her hair. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky can't sleep.
The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards.
The Teletubbies giggle as they stand up and sit down to some music. They watch some children perform a 'Jack in the Box' dance.
Five voice trumpets rises and plays some lovely music for the Teletubbies, who dance around Home Hill. Two girls have brought some new Tropical fish.
Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other.

Tinky Winky and Laa-Laa burst out of the house, dance, have a big hug and go back inside, they do it again until the windmill announces the animals marching through Teletubbyland. Dipsy and Po burst out of the house, dance, have a big hug.
The Teletubbies follow Tinky Winky's star all over Teletubbyland.
A voice trumpet brings a message for the Teletubbies. The Teletubbies watch some children feeding the ducks. Po finds a new trick to play with Tubby Toast. Three ships sail through Teletubbyland.
A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme.
Some children recite and act out a nursery rhyme. In Teletubbyland Po follows Tinky Winky, they go over the hills, along the path, between the trees, into the house, around the toaster and into bed.
Children visit a level crossing and watch a train; animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies dance a twisty dance, then they watch two children rollerblading in New York. The Noo Noo tidies up Tinky Winky's Tubby Toast, so Tinky Winky chases him round and round Home Hill.
Slide game; Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm; the lion and bear play hide-and-seek.
The Teletubbies pop up from behind the hill and rush off to see a little Indian boy playing on a drum called a Tabla. In Teletubbyland, it's time for Tubby Toast.
Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep
The Teletubbies run indoors and then run out again to watch Andy Brown and Georgina wash a baby elephant. Laa-Laa and Dipsy have a messy accident.
Three Teletubbies dance through Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Dipsy climbs a steep hill.
Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

Some voice trumpets rise to wish the Tubbies good morning. The Teletubbies watch some children herding sheep. The Teletubbies go in and out, and up and down, round the corner and along to top until it is time for Tubby Custard.
Laa-Laa dances with her ball; living in a block of flats; balloon.
The Tubbies watch two boys having their hair cut. A mirror appears in Teletubbyland. Laa-Laa, Dipsy and Tinky Winky liked looking at their reflection in the mirror.
The Teletubbies imitate children doing funny walks before attempting funny walks of their own.
The Teletubbies watch a group of children washing their goat in the river. In Teletubbyland it’s time for Tubby Custard. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa spilled custer on themselves.
The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf.
The Teletubbies watch some children making marks. They use paint and different objects to make a colourful picture.
Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.
The Tubbies love to run round and round Teletubbyland, but stop to watch three children make some modelling dough to play with. The Tubby Toaster makes a big piece of Toast.
Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

The Teletubbies watch some children crawling. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies are crawling. Tinky Winky crawled along the path, Dipsy crawled over the hill, Laa-Laa crawled between the trees and Po crawled around the flowers.
The Teletubbies giggle together as they hold hands and side step around Home Hill. They watch three children build a jigsaw puzzle and try to guess what the picture is.
The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing...

The Teletubbies and a group of children see Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hungry horse. In Teletubbyland, Po is playing with Laa-Laa's ball, she doesn't want to give it back until she sees her scooter.
The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes.
The Tubbies dance a Bumps-a-daisy dance and then watch some children decorating lots of boxes to make a big caterpillar. A Jack in a Box appears in Teletubbyland.
It's time for the Teletubbies to exercise; a voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch.
The Teletubbies pop up and run off to watch some children tell a story with their drawings. Laa-Laa goes for a walk and as she walks she sings a song about what she sees.
The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two.
Po and Tinky Winky love to smell flowers. They have great fun running between two groups of flowers smelling them with great big sniffs.
The animals march through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies love playing "Boo!" The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number six. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa get their knees dirty and have fun getting them clean.
Amy cooks pasta at home; Noo-Noo cleans up an unraveled ball of string.
The Teletubbies watch two children and their goats. The dancing Teddy bear appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies sing a song.
Another story about the Naughty Sock; the Tubby toast machine makes a pile of toast.
Teletubbies love to run and do exercises. The Tubbies watch a girl and a boy throwing a ball. Then they play a game together with the ball.
The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.
The Teletubbies watch a little girl whose Mum has a very special job. Po has too much Tubby Custard and Tubby Custard Tummy and there's time foe one more dance before Tubby Bye-Bye.
In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.
A cloud appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies watch some children playing in the rain. Dipsy steps in a puddle. Three magic ships sail through Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies love playing on the slide.
A voice trumpet rises and Laa-Laa and Dipsy play a going up and going down game. They go up the hill and then they go down the hill. They do it again and again.
The Teletubbies learn gymnastic routines from Samira and her friends.
A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.
The number four with Noo Noo; Po draws an oval; black and white; a boy and a girl help milk a cow.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.
Maribel teaches flamenco dancing to two eager students; the Teletubbies wash their feet.
Laa-Laa fells like giving all the other Teletubbies a big hug. But where's Tinky Winky? The Teletubbies watch some children who are going for a walk in the woods.
The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.
It's time for toast in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies and a group of children see Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Yellow Cow.
Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies bounce up and down until they spill their Tubby Custard. The Teletubbies watch a boy digging for potatoes with his Grandmother.
Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies.
The Teletubbies dance around the hills until it is time to watch some children making mosaics from different shapes. Tinky Winky and Po play an in and out game.

The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo.
